original.target_description: Staw (1976), 2 × 2 experiment; main effect of personal responsibility on money allocated to the previously chosen corporate division, collapsing decision consequences. Article page 11 is journal page 37, Table 5.

n.sample_role: Participants in the analytic 2 × 2 ANOVA (119 high responsibility and 120 low responsibility).
n.exclusions: One of 120 high-responsibility participants could not choose a division and was excluded. Analytic n is established from the explicit retained group counts, not printed as a standalone total.
